systems.system: WURI foundational ID (fID) system, Côte d'Ivoire
systems.owner: project implementation unit at the Ministère de l'Emploi et de la Protection Sociale, with the Caisse Nationale d'Assurance Maladie
systems.tiers: pilot launched in June 2024; 500,000 digital authentications a month reported at 3 June 2024

note: A World Bank restructuring paper on the WURI identification programme (class identity); its one civil registration item is an indicator, newborn birth registrations assigned a unique number, at 0 on 3 June 2024 against a target of 5,000,000 by June 2026, and nothing is stated on how offices record events.
